messages:
ali (Eng): @people-ops urgent question: got a same-week foster placement call. Likely to become adoption but not 100% yet. Can we start paid parental leave now or do we need to wait for signed adoption docs?

priya (People Ops): Congrats, Ali! Short answer: we can start paid parental leave for foster placements that are documented as 'placement with intent to adopt'. We need the agency placement letter + Workday leave request. If conversion to adoption later, we'll keep the leave code as parental/adoption.

jo (Payroll): If you want pay to start immediately, send a scanned placement letter + your Workday submission to payroll@redwood.com with subject "PLACEMENT - URGENT". We can retro-adjust if paperwork arrives late but faster is better. Include expected start date in the email.

ali (Eng): Placement likely arrives Wed or Thu. I can do a quick partial ramp for the first week. What does the paperwork timeline look like?

priya (People Ops): If you get the placement letter Wed, you can submit Workday the same day. We usually process within 3 business days for payroll entries. For benefits/top-up forms, fill the "Family Leave Top-Up" e-form (link in DM).

rafa (Manager): On the coverage side: approve temporary backfill up to $8k for 3 weeks. Nate, can Eng Ops get a temp onboarded and handle oncall & merges?

nate (Eng Ops): Yep. We can have someone in 48h after vendor PO and security checklist. Please include the oncall runbook link and a small PR acceptance checklist in the vendor request. Also note: need badge + org-unit access in IAM for repos.

ali (Eng): Thanks — Rafa approved. Priya, can People Ops help with a family-first phased return plan? I might do 3 afternoons/week remote for first 2 weeks then reassess.

priya (People Ops): Absolutely. We have a "Phased Return" template we'll attach in a DM. Recommend 50% first 2 weeks with defined async handoffs, then either full leave or 25% depending on family needs. We'll document in Workday comments so payroll/benefits align.

jo (Payroll): Quick note: Some states have additional leave pay rules for foster/adoption — if you share state (DM is fine) we'll ensure compliance and any state-paid benefits are coordinated.

ali (Eng): I'm in CA — will DM details. Sending placement letter to payroll now with "PLACEMENT - URGENT" subject. Booking 15-min with Priya to fill forms. Appreciate the fast help.

priya (People Ops): Got it. We'll fast-track and loop in Legal if they need to validate agency docs. If placement doesn't convert to adoption, we will switch codes to FMLA/unpaid as required. Keep this thread updated for oncall handoffs. :heart:
